summary: The assistant executed a cleanup pass that renamed internal `activeDomains`/`domainId` terminology to `enabledExtensionIds`/`activeExtensions` across the app, agent-server, and tests via PowerShell bulk replace plus targeted edits to ProjectCapability, SessionCapability, pi-session-factory, and app-settings. It also relocated Unity-specific core CSS by writing a new activity.css inside the activity extension package, importing it from ActivityPanel.svelte, and removing the equivalent activity blocks from apps/app/src/styles/inspector-parts/panels.css.
decisions: Renamed internal field `activeDomains` to `enabledExtensionIds` and `domainId` parameter to `enabledExtensionIds` across apps/app via PowerShell text replace (transcript shows the command and successful write)
Renamed agent-server local `activeDomains` to `activeExtensions` in pi-session-factory.ts while keeping the wire/protocol field `domains` unchanged for compatibility
Updated GitCapability error message from 'No Unity project is selected' to 'No workspace is selected' to remove Unity-specific copy

Moved activity panel styling out of core apps/app styles into the activity extension package by creating packages/activity/src/web/activity.css and importing it from ActivityPanel.svelte, then deleting the equivalent rules from panels.css
